landing.heroBody: Paste a document, see where the cuts fall, and finally understand why that sentence doesn't show up.
landing.problemBody: The passage is in the document. The search doesn't bring it back. And nothing tells you why — until you see the cut.
landing.problemNoteCut: The cut falls right here, mid-sentence — half of "regardless of the original payment method" ends up in the next chunk.
landing.problemNoteTruncation: This chunk is already ~1,100 characters — the model truncates around 1,000, so the customs note never gets embedded.
landing.problemNoteParagraph: No blank line between "4.2 Refunds" and "4.3" → paragraph chunking collapses both sections into one giant chunk.
landing.walkthroughBody: Four steps, one violet thread running underneath all of them.
landing.step1Text: Plain text, no login, never leaves the browser.
landing.step3Text: Every chunk ranked by score, no top-N cutoff.
landing.step4Text: Two strategies side by side, or export the finding.
landing.ctaHeading: Go see where your retrieval fails.
landing.ctaSubtext: No account, no login. Everything runs in your browser.
